CREATE TABLE "public"."devices" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "location" character varying(160) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(120) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "devices_status_check_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT "devices_type_check_3244d763" CHECK ("type" IN ('TEMPERATURE', 'HUMIDITY', 'PRESSURE', 'MULTI_SENSOR'))
)
